topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I heard your surprise party’s been called off, and I reckon you must feel a right sting. I know it’s not the same as when a storm ruins the wheat just as it’s near to harvest, but I can see the weight of disappointment on your shoulders. Here, let me help with these chores, give you a hand with the animals. It’s a clear day, perfect for a turn in the fields, and we can share a bit of talk and maybe a drink of ale at dusk. The saints know we needn’t have reasons for a good cheer, and perhaps this day can still find its joy in the simpler, quieter things.
